exposure: Surgical procedure (Laminoplasty vs. Laminectomy and fusion)
Operative levels (including or excluding C2, T1, and T2)
cohort: Patients over 18 years old who underwent laminoplasty or laminectomy and fusion for degenerative cervical myelopathy at the Mass General Brigham health system between 2017 and 2019.
finding: Inpatient opioid use and length of stay were significantly greater in patients who underwent laminectomy and fusion compared to those who underwent laminoplasty; however, these differences were not significant when constructs including C2, T1, and T2 vertebrae were excluded.
